lines.text: Same customer. Same story. Split across five tools.
Helpin brings support, projects, CRM, meetings and docs into one open-source workspace.
Echo answers the repeat questions from your docs and past conversations, and hands your team the rest.
Bugs arrive with the customer's conversation attached, and a coding agent can prepare the fix for review.
Turn a conversation into a task, or link it to one already underway. No copying.
Email, meeting notes and the linked task live on one customer record.
When the fix ships, Helpin prepares the customer update. A teammate approves it.
Helpin is open source. Self-host it free, or let us run it.
One workspace. The whole story. Try it free at helpin dot A I.
